experiment_data.hypothesis: GRPO hyperparameter tuning + reward weight rebalance: batch=16, LR=5e-5(10x v1b), group=8, steps=100, format_weight=0.05(saturated), provenance=0.475, structural=0.475. Kill criteria: Evi-F1>=0.4152(pass), <0.3852(kill), RE-F1<0.4037(regress)
